tasks.title: Module refresh bug — added module does not update the dashboard
tasks.description: User 5: slow/stale update after adding a module. reloadModules() updates the module list but dependents (dashboard counts, in-flight material search) keep stale data. No pending state on the add control.
acceptance_criteria: Adding a module updates the dashboard count without a manual refresh
A failed add does NOT insert the module into the list
The add control shows a pending state while the request is in flight
Success is confirmed explicitly, not implied
Must not regress: planner and materials still receive the new module

history.note: reproduced against deployed API; reframed from stale-state to latency

tasks.reframe: DOES NOT REPRODUCE as scoped on 2026-10-21. Adding a module refreshes the dashboard correctly: OverviewTab calls loadDashboard() explicitly from the Manage panel's onChanged handler, and the sheet shows 'Adding...' with the button disabled. Measured: click to visible = 2.06s. The cause of user 5's complaint is backend latency, not stale state: /health alone returns in ~0.96-1.05s on the Render free tier, and a module add involves POST + modules + dashboard + activity.
tasks.recommended_scope: Perceived speed, not correctness. Options: optimistic insert of the new module row, and parallelising the post-add refetches. Backend cold start is the dominant cost and is a tier limit, not a code defect.
